scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
Hi ~ Hi ~
This is Smile Assistance.
How may I help you ?
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
您好~您好~这里是微笑服务处。请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
National Event held by the command of ^5577FFHis majesty Tristram the 3rd^000000,
that intends to encourage the nation of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
 to play in more enjoyable atmosphere!
I am ^3355FF' Smile Assistance '^000000,
.. who leads the national event under the name of 
^3355FFSmile throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom~^000000
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
这是奉^5577FF特里斯特拉姆三世陛下^000000之命举办的全国活动，旨在让卢恩·米德加兹王国的居民享受更愉快的游戏氛围！我是^3355FF“微笑服务”^000000的负责人，将在整个王国推广^3355FF“微笑活动”^000000~

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
With simple and easy-to-get items,
I can provide you
^3355FF' Mr. Smile '^000000.
The requirements are followings.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
准备一些简单易得的材料，我就能为您制作^3355FF笑脸面具^000000。所需材料如下：

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
With this event
Everybody will be happy and smile,
getting together with other people,
And will try to make Ragnarok the most enjoyable game in the world.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
通过这次活动，大家都能开心地微笑、彼此交流，一起努力让《仙境传说》成为世界上最有趣的游戏。

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
Congratulations !
Now please take this Mr.Smile.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
恭喜！请收下这顶笑脸面具。

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
His majesty,Tristram the 3rd
has promised to try his best to make Ragnarok better and more enjoyable.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
特里斯特拉姆三世陛下承诺，将竭尽全力让《仙境传说》变得更好、更有趣。

scripts.text:
The fact mentioned above
was announced by
the Public Information Bureau of the Rune-Midgarts Kingom.
scripts.translation: 上述内容由卢恩·米德加兹王国公共信息局发布。

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
Oh - unfortunately
You have not brought
enough items for Mr. Smile.
^3355FF10 Jellopy^000000
^3355FF10 Fluff^000000
^3355FF10 Clover^000000
Please check the requirements above.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
很遗憾，您带来的材料不足以制作笑脸面具。
^3355FF10个杰勒比结晶^000000
^3355FF10个绒毛^000000
^3355FF10个三叶草^000000
请核对以上所需材料。

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
Thank you for visiting us.
We ..
The Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
always try to make Ragnarok
better and more enjoyable game.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
感谢您的光临。我们...卢恩·米德加兹王国始终致力于让《仙境传说》变得更好、更有趣。

scripts.text:
[Smile Girl]
We sincerely ask you
to cooperate.
The fact mentioned above
was announced by the Public Information Bureau of the Rune-Midgarts Kingom.
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
我们诚挚地希望您能配合。以上内容由卢恩·米德加兹王国公共信息局发布。
